notes.title: Changed Pricing, Performance Improvements and Better Objective Instructions.
notes.content:
[b]Changing Game's Price[/b]
Changed price from $6.99 to $4.99 to make the game more accessible and reach a wider audience and player can feel "it worth the price" which will also reduce the refund rate as I was getting 20% Refund Rate also.

[b]Performance Improvement[/b]
Optimized island and increased FPS then previous one.
Achieved FPS at High Settings:

[list]
[*] [i]50-60 FPS[/i] in the Lab (Before it was 35-45)
[*] [i]20-30 FPS[/i] in the Island (Before it was 10-17)
[*] [i]60-65 FPS[/i] in the ocean (No change as it was already optimized)
[/list][i][b]Tested on RTX 2050, 8GB RAM, RYZEN 5500H[/b][/i]

[b]Better Objective Instructions[/b]
Players was getting confused earlier and was leading to time wastage and frustration.
Made Instructions clearer so players won't get confused.

Thanks for playing my game and supporting me :)
I will keep improving it and making new updates, adding easter eggs and much more in the near future.

notes.title: Fixed some bugs and added hint for the lab's code.
notes.content:
What's Fixed ?
After waking up on the boat, player was spawning under water instead of on the boat.

Added a hint for making it easy to find the code for emergency system.

If you faced any bugs or problems, please comment under this post and describe the issue.
If it's regarding performance, I am working regularly and optimizing the performance and testing.
It will get an update soon which will fix performance also.

Thanks :)

notes.title: The Water Isn't Empty
notes.content:
🦖 [b]UNEXTINCTION[/b] [b]–[/b] [b]Dev Teaser: Beneath You[/b]

The sea was calm. The nightmare felt over.

In the distance — a ship. Finally. A chance at rescue.

It blasted its horn. We waved. We believed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620157/704107176e00de5c3228e50b18ee4037d4030a3a.jpg[/img]
Then the ocean changed.

A shadow. A shift. And then…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620157/5ab3c55778afe6e3126f67ef81e9b61d7fb30bdc.jpg[/img]
[b]Something enormous passed right beneath our boat.[/b]

And in the blink of an eye — the monster breached.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620157/c9330869f9e9ebf530b3adcb8a5bdb3eb74e93ed.png[/img]
The Mosasaurus launched from the depths and crushed the ship.

Steel twisted. Screams vanished.
What was meant to save us... never stood a chance.

One of the most chilling moments in [b]UNEXTINCTION[/b], our upcoming cinematic dinosaur survival game.

This is just the beginning.

💬 What would you do if you saw this and your rescue vanished in front of you?
